caption: The drawing depicts a wall-mounted clock with a wooden case. The clock has a circular face with a large brown wooden frame, and the clock face itself is a light beige color with some visible wear or discoloration. The numbers on the clock face are Roman numerals, marked in black from I to XII. There are two clock hands: a long, thin black minute hand pointing at the twelve and a shorter, thicker black hour hand pointing at the nine. The body of the clock is rectangular and made of wood with a visible grain texture, featuring a hinged door in the center with a small round knob on the left side and a visible brass-colored hinge on the right. The door covers the majority of the body beneath the clock face. Below the door, the wood curves outward in a gentle arch, and a small vertical wooden piece extends downward from the bottom. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and there is a faint signature in the lower left corner.
title: Wall Clock
